sentence: Randomly shuffles everyone in the chat into a final pick order once, then lets each person in turn claim one of four fixed rooms.
use_when: A group needs a fair random order to choose rooms or beds on a trip
Someone asks who gets to pick first
People want to claim rooms one at a time in a set order
dont_use_when: You need a yes or no vote or a poll on options
You need to pick just one random winner or flip a coin
The things to choose are not the four built-in rooms, or people should trade after picking
